group: Valid section with no records (null list)

cases.description: When the requested section index is valid but the internal `sections[section]` entry is null, `getSection` should return an empty immutable list.

cases.expected: An unmodifiable list containing the added Record(s)
cases.description: After adding one or more records to a valid section using `addRecord`, `getSection` must return a view that contains those records and is immutable (any attempt to modify it throws UnsupportedOperationException).

cases.expected: UnsupportedOperationException when trying to add a new element to the returned list
cases.description: Verify that the list returned for a populated section is truly unmodifiable.
Section indices less than the minimum allowed should cause `Section.check` to throw an IllegalArgumentException.
Section indices greater than the maximum allowed should cause `Section.check` to throw an IllegalArgumentException.

group: Valid section after removing all records (non‑null empty list)

cases.expected: An unmodifiable empty list (not the shared Collections.emptyList())
cases.description: Add one or more records to section 2, call removeAllRecords(2) so the internal list becomes an empty List (not null), then verify that getSection(2) returns an immutable empty list distinct from Collections.emptyList().

group: Valid section with multiple records preserves order

cases.expected: An unmodifiable list containing the added records in the exact insertion order
cases.description: Add three distinct Record objects to section 1 using addRecord in order R1, R2, R3. getSection(1) must return a list whose iterator yields R1, then R2, then R3, confirming order preservation.

cases.expected: The previously obtained list now includes the newly added record
cases.description: Call getSection(3) when the internal list is empty (null → empty list). Then add a Record to section 3 via addRecord. The list reference obtained earlier should now contain that Record because Collections.unmodifiableList is a view of the underlying mutable list.

group: Valid maximum section index with null internal list

cases.description: Assuming the maximum valid section index is 3, and sections[3] is still null, getSection(3) must return the shared immutable empty list.

group: Immutable list throws UnsupportedOperationException on remove

cases.expected: UnsupportedOperationException when invoking remove on the returned list
cases.description: After adding at least one Record to section 1, retrieve the list via getSection(1) and attempt list.remove(0). The operation must fail with UnsupportedOperationException, confirming the list is truly unmodifiable.

When the Message instance has its internal `sections` field set to null (e.g., via reflection or a faulty constructor), calling `getSection(0)` should throw a NullPointerException while trying to evaluate `sections[section]`.
